heldBillSummary.basis: Congressional Research Service summary, version updated 2026-08-12, read at the bill page.
heldBillSummary.title: Continuing Appropriations and Extensions Act, 2027
heldBillSummary.summary: A stop-gap spending bill. It keeps the federal government funded — mostly at last year's levels — until December 11, 2026, or until the regular spending bills pass, whichever comes first, preventing a shutdown when the budget year starts October 1. It makes exceptions for programs like WIC food aid, small-business loans, disaster relief, the Indian Health Service, and wildfire fighting, and extends expiring programs covering agriculture, flood insurance, cybersecurity, transportation, veterans benefits, and housing.
